name: Amoxicillin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 750 to 1,750 mg/day divided every 8 to 12 hours (for example 500 or 875 mg every 12 hours, or 250 or 500 mg every 8 hours)
1 g amoxicillin + 500 mg clarithromycin + 30 mg lansoprazole, all every 12 hours for 14 days
1 g amoxicillin + 30 mg lansoprazole every 8 hours for 14 days
No 875 mg; 250–500 mg every 12 hours (10–30) or every 24 hours (below 10)

key_interactions.effect: Blocks tubular secretion; higher and longer drug levels (label).
Prolonged prothrombin time / higher INR reported (label).
More skin rash with ampicillin-class drugs (label).

contraindications: Serious hypersensitivity (anaphylaxis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome) to amoxicillin or other beta-lactams

pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 60% of an oral dose in urine in 6 to 8 hours, mostly unchanged

sources.citation: USAntibiotics, LLC. (2026). Amoxicillin capsules, tablets and powder for oral suspension [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA050760, set ID 06e5c07d-d95c-4955-8d35-a4703ca2359e, version effective July 7, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
